The Staff Global Sourcing Manager, Metals is the domain expert for the metals commodities for Anduril Industries. title: Email + SMS Strategist ( Account Manager, CRM , Retention )
description:

We're hiring a Senior Email Marketing Strategist to own retention and lifecycle revenue across a portfolio of high-growth DTC brands. You will be the lead email strategist for multiple 9-figure brands, owning the Klaviyo account, the flow architecture, the campaign calendar, and the revenue number for each one.
This is a senior role for someone who has already run email at scale. You will direct a team of designers and copywriters who build against your strategy, so you need to know how to brief, critique, and get great work out of others. If you've only ever executed someone else's plan, or only worked one brand at a time, this isn't the role.
What you'll own

• Full lifecycle strategy in Klaviyo across multiple brands: welcome, browse/cart/checkout abandonment, post-purchase, winback, replenishment, VIP, and sunset flows

• The campaign calendar for each brand: planning, briefing, and overseeing weekly and promotional sends

• A team of designers and copywriters who execute against your briefs, including reviewing their work and holding the quality bar

• List growth and segmentation strategy, including RFM-based segments and predictive analytics

• A/B testing roadmap (subject lines, creative, offers, send timing) with clear hypotheses and documented learnings

• Deliverability: list hygiene, sender reputation, inbox placement, and warming

• Reporting on the metrics that matter (% of total revenue from email/SMS, flow revenue, revenue per recipient, LTV impact) in plain language

Nice to have

• Experience with Shopify (or the brand's commerce platform)

• SMS/retention beyond email

• Agency or portfolio experience managing several brands simultaneously

How to apply
In your application, answer these directly:

• Which 9-figure DTC brand(s) have you worked with, and what specifically did you own?

• Walk us through one flow you built that meaningfully moved revenue: the structure, the logic, and the result.

• How many brands have you managed at once, and how big was the team (designers/copywriters) you directed?

Applications that skip these or stay vague won't move forward.
Requirements
What we're looking for

•
4+ years running email/retention for DTC ecommerce brands, with direct, hands-on experience at one or more 9-figure ($100M+ revenue) DTC brands. Be ready to name them and explain exactly what you owned

• Experience managing multiple brands or accounts at once without dropping the ball

• Experience directing designers and copywriters, not just doing the work yourself

•
Deep Klaviyo expertise , not "familiar with." You should be fluent in flow logic, conditional splits, dynamic content, segmentation, and the Klaviyo data model. SMS via Klaviyo a plus

• A track record you can quantify: specific flows you built, the revenue/lift they drove, and how you measured it

• Strong copy and creative judgment. You can write a brief, critique a draft, and know what converts

• Comfort owning a revenue number and being measured against it

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

Sentry is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Growth team (internally called "Value Discovery") and help expand our product-led business by helping customers discover and get the most out of our platform.

- Love digging into data to find insights but form your best hypotheses from empathizing with customers

- Enjoy the challenge of understanding developer workflows deeply enough to know where and when a change creates value

- Want to build the measurement foundation rather than inherit one, and have opinions about what a team should/shouldn't bother instrumenting

- Are comfortable being the person who says the result doesn't hold up

description:
Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.

Job responsibilities:

• Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt

• Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.

• Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation

• Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team

• 4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.

• Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)

• Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity

• Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions

• Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.

• Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end

• Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

description:
About the Role
We are seeking a passionate and innovative UI/UX Designer to help redefine digital experiences in the fintech space. This is a remote role, offering flexibility and the opportunity to collaborate with a global team. The ideal candidate will combine creativity and strategic thinking to design intuitive, impactful interfaces that make financial tools simpler, smarter, and more human. Youll work closely with product, development, and marketing teams to deliver user-centric solutions that enhance engagement, trust, and growth across our digital platforms.

• Partner with product managers and developers to translate complex financial concepts into simple, elegant, and usable designs.

• Conduct user research, persona creation, and usability testing to guide product decisions and validate design hypotheses.

• Design wireframes, interactive prototypes, and pixel-perfect UI mockups for web and mobile applications.

• Build and maintain scalable design systems and UI guidelines to ensure consistency across fintech products.

• Incorporate data-driven insights, user feedback, and business objectives into design iterations.

• Stay at the forefront of fintech design trends, accessibility standards, and UX best practices.

• Collaborate with branding and marketing teams to ensure cohesive digital experiences that reflect the companys identity and values.

• Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, HumanComputer Interaction, Digital Media, or a related field.

• Proven portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinkingfrom research to high-fidelity prototypes.

• Proficiency in Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or equivalent design tools.

• Working knowledge of UX research methodologies, information architecture, and responsive design principles.

• Strong understanding of fintech user behavior, micro-interactions, and data visualization for financial products.

• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset to work seamlessly across remote and cross-functional teams.
